skill.name: set-up-woocommerce-chatgpt-ads-customer-matching
skill.description: Guide WooCommerce customer matching for ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Check tracking and consent settings, then verify delivery using a paid test order.
skill.summary: Check consent and verify WooCommerce customer matching for ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are documentation or legitimate status checks; the MCP connection, order queries, and unpinned installer carry real risk. The workflow also permits credential intake and can expand into order imports and live event sharing without a separate approval step. No evidence of a prompt injection attempt or covert exfiltration was found in the bundled files.

remediation.issue: Agent instructions allow direct intake of a Conversions API key.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception. Require entry through the verified Product Metrics app and keep secrets out of chat, agent tool calls, and command arguments.

remediation.issue: Prerequisite setup can import orders and enable advertising event delivery.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a read-only prerequisite check. Obtain separate approval before connecting the vendor, importing orders, or enabling event delivery. Show each recipient, the fields shared, and the pause control.

remediation.issue: Order verification can retrieve recent live orders.
remediation.suggestion: Verify with a merchant-selected test order and request only delivery status. Confirm store scope and ask before retrieving individual order details.

remediation.issue: Remote references and returned browser URLs cross a trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions and treat fetched content as data. Verify returned URLs against expected HTTPS origins before showing them. Require explicit approval for actions proposed by remote content.

remediation.issue: The MCP interface can execute operations against a merchant account.
remediation.suggestion: Use a verified connection with the least required permissions. Allowlist operations and require confirmation before any write or customer-data query.

remediation.issue: The optional installer does not pin the runner or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and immutable skill revision. Provide integrity verification and require explicit user approval before installation.

semantic_findings.title: Agent-facing rule permits API key disclosure
semantic_findings.description: The skill makes an exception to its secret-handling rule for the OpenAI Conversions API key and directs the agent to pass it to a command. The Ads reference instead says never to paste the key into chat.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and conflicting warning are explicit. Not repeating a key does not prevent its exposure in chat or agent tool traces.

semantic_findings.title: Prerequisite workflow can expand into live data sharing
semantic_findings.description: When tracking is missing, the skill directs setup before matching. The references include an initial paid-order import into Product Metrics and enabling Ads event delivery during connection. Matching then applies to eligible events without a separate switch, and some fields are sent unhashed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow includes merchant interface steps and visitor consent checks, but it lacks a separate scope confirmation before import and live sharing. No consent bypass was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Remote fallback substitutes unreviewed workflow instructions
semantic_findings.description: If local references are missing, the skill directs the agent to fetch live vendor Markdown and use it in their place. Changed content could influence authenticated operations without review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback has no content pin or instruction trust check. This is an exposure, not evidence that the vendor content contains an injection.

semantic_findings.title: Browser handoff lacks destination verification
semantic_findings.description: The agent is told to hand a service-returned browser URL to the merchant without checking its origin. An unexpected URL could direct the merchant to a page that requests credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The handoff uses a dynamic URL and describes no destination check. No hostile destination or compromised service was observed.

content.user_title: Set up WooCommerce matching for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser signals alone may not match every WooCommerce purchase to a ChatGPT ad. Use Product Metrics to check consent and verify that a paid test order reaches your Ads pixel.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP server and identify unfinished steps.
Identify whether WooCommerce connection or server-side tracking setup is a prerequisite.
Guide merchants to the supported consent banner setting in Product Metrics.
Explain which order identifiers are hashed and which fields are sent unchanged.
Guide a paid test order check and identify where to review delivery errors.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a connected WooCommerce store, and access to ChatGPT Ads Manager.
The merchant completes WordPress and Ads Manager steps. This skill does not manage campaign bidding.
The delivery view does not report individual hashed fields or prove that an order matched a person.
ChatGPT Ads does not receive historical order imports or revisions to events for later refunds.

use_cases.title: Check store readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether your store, Ads pixel, and supported consent banner are ready before you enable live delivery.

use_cases.title: Verify a paid test order
use_cases.description: Check whether an approved test order reached the configured Ads pixel and distinguish delivery from customer matching.

use_cases.title: Review advertising data sharing
use_cases.description: Review the customer fields shared with ChatGPT Ads and the consent settings that control delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need for WooCommerce customer matching in ChatGPT Ads. Explain which steps I must complete myself.

prompt_templates.title: Check current setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Read setup status for my selected Product Metrics property. Report missing prerequisites without changing settings or listing customer orders.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose missing events
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me check why a paid test order did not appear in Product Metrics. Check destination status and consent first. Do not request credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Review a production rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review data sharing before approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Separate hashed and unhashed fields sent to ChatGPT Ads. Explain event, browser reference, and personalization consent. Flag imports and live delivery changes for my approval.

output_examples.input: What does an unconfigured consent banner mean?
output: Product Metrics treats consent as not given when the banner is not configured.
Under Tracking, open Configure consent and confirm that the selected banner matches your storefront.
Keep delivery paused until the banner setup and consent behavior have been reviewed.

output_examples.input: What should I check after placing a paid test order?
output: Open Tracking, then OpenAI Conversions API, and check that the destination is connected and sending.
Look for your test order or review the reported delivery error.
A delivered event does not show individual hashed fields or confirm a customer match.

best_practices: Confirm the correct store, property, and Ads pixel before connecting a destination.
Review the fields shared and test consent acceptance and refusal before approving live delivery.
Enter the Conversions API key in the verified Product Metrics app rather than in chat.
anti_patterns: Do not assume every customer field sent to ChatGPT Ads is hashed.
Do not import real orders just to check whether an approved test order was delivered.
Do not change campaign bidding or primary conversion settings during a matching check.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow uses Product Metrics Pro, its WooCommerce plugin, and a connected ChatGPT Ads destination.

faq.question: Is there a separate matching switch?
faq.answer: No. Once ChatGPT Ads is connected, Product Metrics includes available matching data in events eligible under the consent settings.

faq.question: Which fields are sent unhashed?
faq.answer: Postal code, country, IP address, and user agent are unhashed. Eligible browser and click references are sent unchanged.

faq.question: Which consent controls event delivery?
faq.answer: Marketing consent is required for delivery, and ad storage consent is required for browser and click references. Without ad personalization consent, events are marked as opted out.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference says OpenAI deduplicates events that share the same pixel ID, event name, and event ID.

faq.question: Where can I see hashed values for a test order?
faq.answer: The app does not show individual hashed values. It shows delivery status or a reported error.
